text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. To report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing and Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard café permit located at 270 Wellington Street West, Unit #8, Blue Jays Way flankage.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of Item TE11.19 indefinitely.
